name: analytics-cjs-build
goal: Keep analytics persistence available to Bun while its desktop CommonJS bundle passes the existing Node syntax check.

evidence: At e812 on harbor-mbp-2 the existing game build case fails because the desktop CommonJS bundle contains import.meta from AnalyticsRepository; Node syntax validation rejects it.
The existing case catches the syntax failure but does not prove a cold Node import of the bundled analytics boundary or real Bun SQLite persistence. Extend that same build case with both checks.
Clean snapshot 27ff791f failed the unchanged game build case with Node 24 rejecting import.meta in main.cjs; red record 7771f3fa8a0c4628f5e54f48d5f2857dac5a605bd82bbf6fb9d19bfa4a56bb83.

Use an executable-based require base for Bun builtins and translate only the sandbox resolver in desktop CommonJS builds. Native source and packaged synthetic sandbox checks passed; real providers remain unqualified.

The same clean-snapshot test passed at 32e0552b under the identical guarded environment; red record 0cd22d9358f20d061de36b7cb11842ef1330a6c75394e70baa44446dba5b1765 and green record a75ae2ccb92a8302183f93b62256f8f0ee8184b3fb08177bf3748ce9001bad87.

title: Prove both original loader failures remain detectable.
